critics.notes: Complete pipeline structure: mid-thought lede with thesis, pull-stat, counterargument, limitations, actionable advice, references section, methodology disclaimer. Headline earns the click without distorting the data. Kicker (Sobriety Report) fits Dale's desk. Weakness: only one pull-stat; a second quantitative anchor (e.g. hit-and-run 23.8% as pull) would strengthen scannability.

Distinctly Dale: 'the disclaimer desk gets its innings', 'Comforting, right.', 'the danger moved from the mirror to the windshield', 'alcohol rarely drives alone, so to speak'. Sardonic sports-stat cadence, opinions present (rideshare credit cheaper than everything else on this page; test more drivers). No generic AI phrasing. Slightly restrained vs his meanest outings, but voice is unmistakable.

No identifiable victims, no voyeurism. Targets a data trend, not a person. Actionable advice for parents, walkers, policymakers is proportionate and non-preachy. Does not moralize youth; compliance-not-statute framing is fair. No stereotyping of victims; the 'drunk pedestrian' stereotype is retired by the data itself.

Headline is quotable and shareable; 15.6% pull-stat is the takeaway graphic. 'The danger moved from the mirror to the windshield' is the social line. Risks: impairment-among-youth topic can attract blame-the-kids pile-ons, but the article's compliance framing preempts it. Strong discussion fodder.

No named persons or entities accused. Statistics attributed to GHSA/NHTSA with citations. Causation explicitly hedged; limitations disclaimer is prominent. Zero defamation or negligence exposure. No regulatory advice stated as fact.

Counterargument (testing-bias/measurement) is dedicated and honest. Hit-and-run 23.8% blind spot, incomplete BAC reporting, 2024 data vintage, small numerator, association-not-causation all disclosed. Numbers (7.2% to 15.6%, more than doubled, 23.8%, 62%) all sourced to GHSA report/release with figure-level citation. Weakness: cannot distinguish testing-intensity from behavior; stated as hypothesis. Sources: 3 primary (GHSA report, GHSA release, FARS portal) + 1 secondary (Sept 9, 2026).

Single pull-stat is clean and the one number the piece needs. Inline superscript citations map to a references section with working URLs. Limitations disclaimer is explicit. Improvement noted: a second pull (hit-and-run share or 1-in-6 vs 1-in-14 framing) would reinforce the visual data layer; acceptable as-is since every figure is sourced in-line.

decision: ALL SEVEN PASS at 8.5+. Proceeding to SHIP_BLOCKED queue; #878 already consumed 2026-09-11 Pacific publish slot, so #879 ships 2026-09-12 at the earliest.
